learnings: The provided REST dependency spec does not contain an offers endpoint, so findOffersForDate is implemented as BFF-owned behavior from the GraphQL contract.
Official v3 configuration pages do not show a GraphQL runOptions example; Enterprise 1.19.1 accepts the graphqlsdl runOptions key with host and port.
Enterprise 1.19.1 accepts specmatic.governance.report.formats for HTML and CTRF report configuration.
Test defaults use 127.0.0.1 instead of localhost so the Spring client and Specmatic mock use the same IPv4 loopback address.
The REST dependency models pageSize as a header on GET /products, so the BFF forwards the optional GraphQL pageSize argument as that header.
Specmatic's console reports 84 tests for schemaResiliencyTests: all while the generated CTRF summary records 81 report entries for the same passing run.
The GraphQL Date scalar wraps parse failures in coercion exceptions so invalid date literals produce GraphQL errors instead of framework 500 JSON.
